title: /onboarding/step-1 renders the organization details form
steps: As a newly bootstrapped onboarding session, navigate to /onboarding/step-1
expectedResult: The page renders 'Tell us about your organization' with Industry and Company size selects and a Continue button, wrapped by the Stepper showing step 1 active.

title: GET /api/v1/onboarding/state returns 200 for an authenticated user
steps: Call GET /api/v1/onboarding/state with a valid bootstrap or Keycloak token
expectedResult: Response is 200 with currentStep, completedSteps, and setupHealthScore fields present.

title: SetupChecklist widget renders on /dashboard for an org with incomplete setup
expectedResult: The Setup Checklist card is visible in the bottom-right of the viewport with a progress bar and up to 5 checklist items.

title: Platform tour starts and mounts its overlay and tooltip without console errors
steps: Trigger startTour() from its entry point
Observe the browser console and DOM
expectedResult: The tour overlay/spotlight and tooltip mount over the first configured TOUR_STEPS target with no uncaught console errors.

title: Completing step-1 advances currentStep to step-2
expectedResult: Response is 200 with completedSteps including 'step-1' and currentStep 'step-2'.
